forbids: a vendored requirement spine that no longer matches the nist-csf artifacts it was cut from
note: One half, and it is behavioural: there is no static shape that can express 'these two files agree'. Vendoring buys standalone operation (BL-169 D-1) and costs exactly one thing — two copies that can disagree silently, with the wrong one shipping and nothing erroring.

mutations.why: one family label edited in the vendored copy. This is what drift looks like from the inside: a single plausible string, and no other test in the repository has any opinion about it.
defeats: the vendored spine regenerates identically from the nist-csf sources
